<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_update_xml">

        <payload><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sa_pattern"><sa_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><ci_type>cmdb_ci_nat_gateway</ci_type><cpattern_type>4</cpattern_type><description/><directory>false</directory><enforce_proc_classy>false</enforce_proc_classy><invoke_per_account>false</invoke_per_account><metadata_id>73f8b94cdb4f44109149f2131f961956</metadata_id><name>Amazon AWS - NAT Gateway (LP)</name><ndl>pattern {
	metadata {
		id = "73f8b94cdb4f44109149f2131f961956"
		name = "Amazon AWS - NAT Gateway (LP)"
		description = ""
		citype = "cmdb_ci_nat_gateway"
		apply_to_os_families = "cmdb_ci_aws_datacenter"
	}
	identification {
		name = "Amazon NAT Gateway"
		entry_point {type = "*"}
		find_process_strategy {strategy = NONE}
		step {
			name = "Extract AWS Host"
			set_attr {
				"awsHost"
				eval {"javascript: rtrn = \"\";
var host = '';
var region = ${cmdb_ci_aws_datacenter[1].name};
var dc_url = ${service_account[1].datacenter_url};

try {
   var hostBuilder = new AWSHostBuilder();
   host = hostBuilder.extractAWSHost(region,dc_url);
   if (host.startsWith(\".\")) {
      host = host.substring(1, host.length);
   }
}
catch (e){
   ms.log(\"AWSHostBuilder Class Not Found, or Run Failed. Make sure you have installed the latest discovery patterns store release. \" + e);
   if(dc_url.contains(\"gov\")){
      var gov_region = dc_url.split(\".\")[1];
      host = gov_region + '.amazonaws.com';
   } else {
      host = 'amazonaws.com';
   }
}

//remove the last character if it is forward slash, because the URLs later on always add forward slash as hardcoded character
var last_symbol = host[host.length - 1]
if (last_symbol == \"/\") {
      host = host.substring(0,host.length - 1)
}

rtrn = host;"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set Full URL"
			set_attr {
				"awsQueryUrl"
				concat {
					"https://ec2."
					get_attr {"awsHost"}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Get Nat Gateway"
			ref {refid = "55ec06d49844498eb596ace0ba373af4"}
		}
		step {
			name = "Check if there are NAT Gateways"
			match {
				is_not_empty {get_attr {"natgateway"}}
				terminate_op = graceful
				terminate_msg = "NAT Gateway is empty"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Create Network"
			parse_var_to_var {
				from_var_name = "cmdb_ci_endpoint_nat[*].network_native_key"
				to_var_names = table {
					name = "cmdb_ci_network"
					col_names = "source_native_key"
				}
				parsing_strategy = delimited_parsing {
					exclude_lines_pattern = "null"
					selected_positions = 1
				}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Remove duplicate Networks"
			set_attr {
				"tmp"
				eval {"javascript: var tableWithoutDuplicates = '';
tableWithoutDuplicates =  DuplicateRemover.removeDuplicates(${cmdb_ci_network},[\"source_native_key\"]);
CTX.setAttribute(\"cmdb_ci_network\", tableWithoutDuplicates);"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Relation between NAT Gateway and LDC"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_nat_gateway"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_aws_datacenter"
				result_table_name = "nat_to_ldc"
				unmatched_lines = keep
				relation_type = "Hosted on::Hosts"
				ref_direction = parentToChild
				ref_field_name = ""
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Relation between NAT Gateway and NAT Endpoint Gateway"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_nat_gateway"
				key1_name = "natid"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_endpoint_nat"
				key2_name = "natid"
				result_table_name = "nat_to_nat_ep"
				unmatched_lines = remove
				relation_type = "Implement End Point To::Implement End Point From"
				ref_direction = parentToChild
				ref_field_name = ""
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Create relation between Network and NAT Endpoint Gateway"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_network"
				key1_name = "source_native_key"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_endpoint_nat"
				key2_name = "network_native_key"
				result_table_name = "network_to_nat_ep"
				unmatched_lines = remove
				relation_type = "Use End Point To::Use End Point From"
				ref_direction = parentToChild
				ref_field_name = ""
			}
		}
	}
}
